candidates.trendDescription: Football fandom, match-day watch parties, national-team identity, and collectible moments around the 2026 World Cup.

evidence.note: Official FIFA tournament page confirms the 2026 World Cup timing and event scale.
LEGO sports catalog fit is directionally useful, but not specific proof of a current World Cup campaign.

candidates.oneLineVerdict: Huge cultural surface, but LEGO needs a sharper licensed or fan-ritual angle to avoid generic football posting.
candidates.recommendedCampaign: Build match-day rituals around modular stadium scenes, country-color micro-builds, and family watch-party content before committing to paid media.

candidates.trendDescription: Race-weekend fandom, team identity, car design, engineering storytelling, and adult collector culture around Formula 1.

evidence.note: LEGO has a Formula 1 category surface, making the product-trend bridge direct rather than forced.
LEGO Speed Champions provides an existing creative format for car builds, race-weekend content, and collector display.
Formula 1 coverage of the LEGO partnership supports current relevance for race-weekend activation.
The partnership context keeps the activation inside a mainstream entertainment and family-friendly collecting lane.
The Formula 1 category supports overlap between LEGO buyers, adult collectors, motorsport fans, and gift shoppers.

candidates.oneLineVerdict: Best fit: LEGO already has a direct F1 product bridge, strong creative formats, and a natural adult-collector angle.
candidates.recommendedCampaign: Run a race-weekend builder series: pit-wall desk builds, team-color display shots, parent-child qualifying challenges, and creator videos that connect engineering detail to collectible pride.

candidates.trendDescription: Graduation gifts, school-year milestones, keepsakes, desk decor, and family celebration posts.

evidence.note: LEGO gift navigation supports giftability, but this is broad gift evidence rather than graduation-specific conversion proof.
Graduation gifting is low-risk and family-safe, but it is more seasonal retail than a distinctive brand trend.

candidates.oneLineVerdict: Safe and giftable, but less distinctive than F1 because many brands can participate in graduation gifting.
candidates.recommendedCampaign: Use graduation as a seasonal retail lane: desk-friendly display builds, flower sets, and keepsake messaging for parents and friends.
